context.canonical_title: 如何保证 MySQL 与 Redis 的缓存一致性？

required_checks: Verify Redis cache-aside read/write invalidation and TTL-bounded-staleness semantics against current Redis official documentation.
Verify Redis DEL behavior and do not overstate repeated deletion as an end-to-end idempotency guarantee.
Verify MySQL 8.4 transaction/binary-log ordering and commit boundaries; distinguish database durability from downstream CDC delivery.
Verify the outbox/CDC claims against current Debezium official documentation and keep outbox, binlog and application worker responsibilities distinct.
Check stale-read race windows, delayed double-delete limitations, hot-key stampede handling, retry/dead-letter/replay, binlog-retention recovery, observability and capacity boundaries.
Verify all source variants are directly answered and hypothetical project examples cannot be read as fabricated personal experience.
review_contract.promotion_boundary: Do not promote or fabricate human approval. Pilot human review remains a separate mandatory gate when required by config.

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Redis cache-aside
claims_to_check: cache-aside reads primary on miss and repopulates Redis
writes invalidate the cache key rather than assuming cache is always latest
TTL bounds stale-data lifetime and hot-key expiration can cause stampedes

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Redis DEL command
claims_to_check: DEL removes keys and missing keys do not create a replacement value
repeated deletion is safe only for the cache-key side effect, not a proof of distributed exactly-once delivery

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 The Binary Log
claims_to_check: transactional table changes are cached until COMMIT and the transaction is written to the binary log before COMMIT completes
binary logging is ordered with transaction completion but does not itself guarantee an external consumer has applied cache invalidation

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 START TRANSACTION, COMMIT, and ROLLBACK
claims_to_check: InnoDB transaction commit/rollback boundaries and transaction logging behavior

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Debezium Outbox Event Router
claims_to_check: outbox pattern stores service state and event state so CDC can reliably relay committed outbox changes
the Debezium connector captures outbox-table changes and applies the outbox event router
